fn render(control: &mut Consumer<Record>, frames: usize) {
    let mut cursor = 0;
    while cursor < frames {
        let available = control.available_at_entry();
        for _ in 0..available {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            apply(record);
        }
        cursor += 16;
    }
}
